activity_summary: You ran the cup once, and Nick stayed under the note. Pope kept one of the Nurse's stops for Saturday. Kemp held Peter to the fan and the half-song he is not let finish. Cowley showed a blot on Benvolio's roll, and you promised a clean copy of the cues tonight, not a new speech. You named January, October, and August's five shillings as the reason. The afternoon play is Errors, and you are Egeon.

quotes.speaker: nick_sorrell
quotes.text: I can hold it if I come in under the note, sir. If I come in on it, it goes.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: Nine-and-twenty lines in the whole book, Sweet Master Shakespeare, a fan to carry, and half a song I am not let finish.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tonight. You covered me in January and in October, and you took August at five shillings without a complaint.
